# WTVR

> CBS 6 Richmond's news and information hub delivering breaking local news, weather, traffic, and community programming for Central Virginia.

WTVR (CBS 6) serves the Richmond metropolitan area with comprehensive news coverage, real-time traffic and weather updates, and award-winning community programming. The station combines local journalism with national news aggregation and features multiple community-focused initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Richmond, Virginia
- CBS 6
- Central Virginia
- Local News
- Weather & Traffic
- Crime & Justice
- Community Events
- Sports Coverage
- National News
- Regional Stories
- Prince George County
- Henrico County
- Chesterfield County
- Community Programs

## Breaking News & Local Coverage

- [Local News from WTVR CBS 6 Richmond](https://www.wtvr.com/news/local-news): Breaking news, weather, traffic and sports coverage for Richmond metro area
- [Crime and Justice](https://www.wtvr.com/news/crime-and-justice): Crime and justice coverage for Richmond, Central Virginia counties
- [National News](https://www.wtvr.com/news/national-news): National news aggregation from Scripps, CBS 6 News and wire services
- [International News](https://www.wtvr.com/news/international-news): International news coverage including Middle East conflicts and global events

## Weather & Traffic

- [Weather](https://www.wtvr.com/weather): Weather forecasts, radar, and alerts from CBS 6 Weather Authority
- [Traffic reports for Richmond, Virginia](https://www.wtvr.com/traffic): Real-time traffic reports and commute information for Richmond, Virginia

## Community & Education Programs

- [Building Better Minds](https://www.wtvr.com/building-better-minds): Award-winning series featuring inspiring educators and community stories
- [Battle of the Brains on CBS 6](https://www.wtvr.com/on-air/battle-of-the-brains): High school quiz show competition airing Saturdays on CBS 6
- [Paws for Pets](https://www.wtvr.com/community/paws-for-pets): Pet adoption program featuring animals from Richmond SPCA and shelters

## Community Engagement

- [Community Advisory Council](https://www.wtvr.com/community/community-advisory-council): WTVR-TV CBS 6 Community Advisory Council membership and engagement
